problems.queue_item_not_cancellable: This item is being sent right now or is already finished, so it can no longer be cancelled.
problems.queue_read_only: Events are a record of what happened and are never cancelled. Pause the queue on the Cluster screen instead.
problems.queue_confirmation_required: Type the queue name exactly to cancel the whole queue.

queues.title: Queues
queues.subtitle: Mail, webhook deliveries and system mail waiting to go out. Cancel single items, everything matching a filter, or a whole queue.
queues.select_hint: Select items to cancel them, or filter and cancel everything that matches.
queues.select_all: Select every cancellable item on this page
queues.job_failed: The cancellation stopped with an error. Items cancelled so far stay cancelled.
queues.job_cancelled: The cancellation was stopped after {n} items.
queues.empty_body_sending: No message is waiting to be sent. Scheduled and retrying messages show up here.
queues.empty_body_webhooks: No webhook delivery is waiting. Retrying and dead-lettered deliveries show up here.
queues.empty_body_systemMail: No system mail is waiting. Sign-in codes, invitations and resets show up here while they wait.
queues.cancel_matching_body: Every item that matches the current filters and is not being sent right now will be cancelled: up to {n} items. Items queued after you confirm are not touched.
queues.cancel_entire_body_org: Every waiting item of this organisation in this queue will be cancelled. Items being sent right now finish normally.
queues.cancel_entire_body_all: Every waiting item of every organisation in this queue will be cancelled. Items being sent right now finish normally. This is recorded in the audit log.
queues.cancelled_some: Cancelled {n} items. {skipped} could not be cancelled because they were being sent or already finished.
queues.nothing_matched: Nothing to cancel: no waiting item matches.
queues.need_filter: Choose at least one filter first, or cancel the entire queue.
queues.cancel_one_body: The item is removed from the queue and will not be sent or delivered. This cannot be undone.
queues.cancel_selected_body: The selected items are removed from the queue and will not be sent or delivered. Items being sent right now are skipped. This cannot be undone.
